title: Selection Sort
definition: Selection Sort repeatedly finds the smallest remaining value and places it into the next sorted position.
realLifeExample: It is like scanning a list of marks, picking the smallest one, and placing it first before repeating the process.

algorithm.Iterative:
(Selection Sort) SELECT(DATA, N)

1. Repeat for K = 1 to N - 1.
2. Set MIN := DATA[K] and LOC := K.
3. Scan J = K + 1 to N.
4. If DATA[J] is smaller than MIN, update MIN and LOC.
5. Interchange DATA[K] and DATA[LOC].
6. Exit.
algorithm.Functions:
FUNCTION SELECT(DATA, N)

1. For each position K, call FIND_MIN(DATA, K, N).
2. Receive the location LOC of the smallest value.
3. Swap DATA[K] with DATA[LOC].
4. Return DATA.

MAIN:
1. Read N and DATA.
2. Call SELECT(DATA, N).
3. Print DATA.
algorithm.Recursion:
FUNCTION SELECT_REC(DATA, K, N)

1. If K = N, return.
2. Find the location LOC of the minimum item from K to N.
3. Swap DATA[K] and DATA[LOC].
4. Call SELECT_REC(DATA, K + 1, N).
